pick.headline: Second coup attempt in a year in Venezuela
pick.summary: On November 27, 1992, rebel officers tried for the second time that year to overthrow President Carlos Andres Perez of Venezuela, seizing a television station and bombing Caracas from the air before being defeated.
pick.significance: The failure of both 1992 coups left Perez weakened; he was impeached the following year. The February attempt had been led by Hugo Chavez.
pick.fbis: FBIS's Latin America summary of November 27, 1992, reported international and local media saying a coup led by the 'Revolutionary Bolivarian Movement 200' was under way, with fighting in Caracas.

alternates.headline: Medellin cartel bombs Avianca flight 203
alternates.summary: On November 27, 1989, a bomb planted by the Medellin cartel destroyed Avianca flight 203 shortly after take-off from Bogota, killing all 107 aboard.
alternates.significance: The bombing was part of Pablo Escobar's war against extradition to the United States; two Americans were among the dead, which gave US courts jurisdiction.
alternates.fbis: Madrid's EFE reported from Bogota on November 27 that an Avianca Boeing 727 with 107 people aboard had exploded shortly after take-off, with no survivors reported.
